history.notes: Improved playback stability and navigation performance.

Sign-in is now with your GitHub account: enter a short code, no email or Google login.
Switching devices no longer risks losing your favorites and playlists.
TV sign-in works over its own Wi-Fi without needing the computer.
Dubbing no longer repeats the same phrase in a loop.
Dubbing now starts cleanly with no wrong language or chatbot phrases.
fix(dub): no wrong language, no repetition, no chatbot output during warm-up
fix(dub): skip phrase on translation timeout — no more garbage TTS during cold-start
Upgrade Android build toolchain to AGP 9.3 and Gradle 9.5.
Upgrade Electron to v44 and koffi to v3.1 for better performance.
Library upgrades: smoother TV playback and faster voice recognition.
Arabic captions now steer to the right register per channel.
